sampling.eligibility_rule: Exact source venue match by documented A/B/C source plan; named supplemental sources excluded from primary counts
sampling.time_window: Selected mostly 2024-2026; 2017 foundation and 2021 AOA exceptions
sampling.population_note: Some outcomes are health proxies, child safety perception, or youth rather than five developmental outcomes; do not equate labels

papers.title: A systematic review of the impact of the urban environment on the health of school-age children and adolescents: Current landscape and future directions
papers.probe_reason: 136 studies; 263 reported associations across child/youth outcomes; map plausible exposure and outcome dimensions

papers.title: Constructing child-friendly cities: Comprehensive evaluation of street-level child-friendliness using the method of empathy-based stories, street view images, and deep learning
papers.probe_reason: Street-level indicators can capture child-specific perceptions, but child-friendliness is not an observed health outcome

papers.title: Availability and accessibility of public open spaces and sports facilities and children's visit patterns: Evidence from smartwatch signaling data
papers.probe_reason: Differentiates accessibility/availability and children’s behavior; behavior is not clinical/developmental outcome

papers.title: The smarter the city develops, the healthier the child grows? Evidence from China
papers.probe_reason: County-scale child growth outcomes and regional heterogeneous policy effects; not evidence of road-scale extrapolation

papers.title: UST-GNN: A unified spatial–topological graph neural network framework for urban analytics demonstrated through a case study on urban health prediction
papers.probe_reason: Closest urban-health GNN; London spatial CV and held-out borough tests; prescription outcomes, not child development

papers.title: Family specific spatial borrowing in multimodal urban reconstruction: a leave one neighborhood out study of Cincinnati
papers.probe_reason: Negative counterexample: local nonlinear features can match or exceed graph models depending on feature family
papers.publication_note: Article available online in 2026; volume issue dated March 2027.

papers.title: Modeling adolescents’ perception of cycling safety: A new approach using graph neural networks and street view imagery
papers.probe_reason: Child/adolescent-oriented road network GNN; outcome is cycling safety perception, not health

papers.title: Quantifying uncertainty in deep learning models for urban safety perception: An MC Dropout approach
papers.venue: Environment and Planning B: Urban Analytics and City Science
papers.probe_reason: Uncertainty-aware urban perception prediction; indirect relevance to reliability of extrapolated health surfaces

papers.title: Inductive Representation Learning on Large Graphs
papers.probe_reason: GraphSAGE neighbor sampling and inductive embeddings; unseen nodes/graphs do not guarantee child-health distribution-shift robustness

papers.title: SatCLIP: Global, General-Purpose Location Embeddings with Satellite Imagery
papers.probe_reason: Reusable geographic location embedding; potential baseline/feature source subject to coverage, cost and leakage

papers.title: DIVE: Subgraph Disagreement for Graph Out-of-Distribution Generalization
papers.probe_reason: Graph OOD method; paper evaluates graph-level datasets, not guaranteed transferable to road-node regression

papers.title: Learning Complex Scene Segmentation from Noisy Label
papers.probe_reason: Negative transfer/control: noisy image segmentation labels differ materially from child-to-road aggregation noise

papers.title: Neighborhood playability and early childhood development: a population-based birth cohort study
papers.probe_reason: Most endpoint-specific study: 30126-child cohort, Early Development Instrument; out of A venue list so separately marked

papers.title: Predicting into unknown space? Estimating the area of applicability of spatial prediction models
papers.probe_reason: AOA/DI transferability audit and validation-design constraint; outside A/B/C source watchlists

papers.title: Spatial process-based transfer learning for prediction problems
papers.probe_reason: SpTrans small-target-sample process/transfer approach tested on land prices; outside A/B/C watchlists

papers.title: A Survey of Deep Graph Learning under Distribution Shifts: From Graph Out-of-Distribution Generalization to Adaptation
papers.venue: ACM Transactions on Knowledge Discovery from Data
papers.probe_reason: Technical context taxonomy of OOD generalization versus domain adaptation; outside explicit C watchlist
